items.Sentence: Fine screens will be provided upstream of the MBR tanks to remove particulate material

The MBR process will consist of biological treatment utilizing anoxic, aerobic, and deoxygenation tanks, followed by submerged membrane ultrafiltration. The MBR process will remove carbonaceous biochemical oxygen demand, nitrogen through nitrification and denitrification
The HAWPF RO system will consist of ... pretreatment (chloramine injection, sulfuric acid and antiscalant addition), cartridge filters, two RO trains

an ultraviolet (UV) disinfection/advanced oxidation process (UV/AOP). Chloramine will be dosed upstream of the UV reactors to generate hydroxyl radicals and to provide a chlorine residual to achieve additional disinfection in the effluent pipeline

Post-treatment stabilization includes calcite contactors ... used to adjust pH, add alkalinity and hardness... Sodium hypochlorite and liquid ammonium sulfate will be added post-stabilization to provide a 2 milligrams per liter (mg/L) chloramine residual
a single odor control unit consisting of a single-bed carbon adsorber
HAWPF recycled water will be pumped to the product water tank for storage and equalization
